constraint_solvers.description: Algorithms that generate content by satisfying constraints. Wave Function Collapse propagates adjacency rules, Boolean patterns combine logical operations, Model Synthesis builds 3D structures from examples.
learning_objectives: Wave Function Collapse: entropy-based cell selection
Constraint propagation: local rules, global coherence
Tile adjacency: what can be next to what

artifact_groups.rationale: Wave Function Collapse: 2D tiles and 3D blocks generated by propagating adjacency constraints. Observe the lowest-entropy cell, collapse it, propagate — quantum metaphor as world-building.
WFC dungeon generator: room-based constraint satisfaction producing explorable spaces. Dark sphere anchors the generated architecture as rooms tile coherently from adjacency rules.
Boolean pattern synthesis: logical operations (AND, OR, XOR) combining geometric patterns. Constraint satisfaction through boolean algebra — a different formalism reaching the same generative power.
